title: Synced attribute keys missed on 1.21+
releases: 1.21-1.21.11, 26.1 (audit scope; 26.2 and 26.3 read the same way)

evidence.vanillaSource: mineflayer entities.js: entity.attributes[prop.key ?? prop.name]; minecraft-data pc/1.21-26.3 protocol packet_entity_update_attributes key mapper
evidence.regression: test/attributes.test.cjs: reads each consumed attribute by the very key the protocol hands mineflayer, from 1.20.5

note: The test reads the key mapper of each release's update_attributes packet, which is the key mineflayer stores a synced attribute under, and requires attributeKey to give exactly that key for every attribute the adapter consumes on 1.20.5-26.3, and a state built from that key to reach the engine. It fails if attributeKey drops the namespace (checked by mutating it). fixedBy is the commit of the regression; the key fix itself is the corrected minecraft-data.

title: 1.17-1.21.1 riptide lift skips fire part of move
note: launch_riptide runs the lift's powder snow and fire part (piston::apply_powder_snow, as a piston's move) before 1.21.2, the fire test before 1.17 included. The test's burning server player in the rain is put out by the lift on 1.17 and 1.21.1, so its frozen ticks survive the base tick; 1.21.2 leaves them to it.

title: 26.3 elytra start read a stale lava flag

evidence.regression: test/mineflayer.test.cjs: asks the lava of this tick, not the flag the last one left (26.3)

note: A 26.3 player in lava with a stale isInLava false starts no glide and one out of lava with a stale true does; 26.2 asks the water only. The test fails without updateFluids' lava refresh.
